import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def calculate_indicators(df):
    # Calculate On Balance Volume (OBV)
    df['OBV'] = np.where(df['Close'] > df['Close'].shift(1), df['Volume'], -df['Volume']).cumsum()
    
    # Calculate Average Directional Index (ADX)
    df['Plus_DM'] = np.where((df['High'] - df['High'].shift(1)) > (df['Low'].shift(1) - df['Low']), (df['High'] - df['High'].shift(1)), 0)
    df['Minus_DM'] = np.where((df['Low'].shift(1) - df['Low']) > (df['High'] - df['High'].shift(1)), (df['Low'].shift(1) - df['Low']), 0)
    df['Plus_DI'] = df['Plus_DM'].rolling(14).mean() / df['ATR']
    df['Minus_DI'] = df['Minus_DM'].rolling(14).mean() / df['ATR']
    df['DX'] = np.abs(df['Plus_DI'] - df['Minus_DI']) / (df['Plus_DI'] + df['Minus_DI'])
    df['ADX'] = df['DX'].rolling(14).mean()
    
    # Calculate Average True Range (ATR)
    df['HL'] = df['High'] - df['Low']
    df['HC'] = np.abs(df['High'] - df['Close'].shift(1))
    df['LC'] = np.abs(df['Low'] - df['Close'].shift(1))
    df['TR'] = df[['HL', 'HC', 'LC']].max(axis=1)
    df['ATR'] = df['TR'].rolling(14).mean()
    
    # Calculate Moving Average (MA)
    df['MA_50'] = df['Close'].rolling(50).mean()
    df['MA_200'] = df['Close'].rolling(200).mean()
    
    return df

def generate_signals(df):
    signals = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    signals['long'] = np.where((df['OBV'] > df['OBV'].shift(1)) & (df['ADX'] > 20) & (df['Close'] > df['MA_50']) & (df['ATR'] < 2*df['ATR'].rolling(28).mean()), 1, 0)
    signals['short'] = np.where((df['OBV'] < df['OBV'].shift(1)) & (df['ADX'] > 20) & (df['Close'] < df['MA_50']) & (df['ATR'] > 2*df['ATR'].rolling(28).mean()), -1, 0)
    
    return signals

def calculate_position_size(equity, risk_percentage):
    return equity * risk_percentage

def calculate_stop_loss(price, percentage):
    return price * (1 - percentage)

def calculate_take_profit(price, percentage):
    return price * (1 + percentage)

def backtest(df, signals, initial_equity, risk_percentage, stop_loss_percentage, take_profit_percentage):
    positions = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    positions['long'] = signals['long'].cumsum()
    positions['short'] = signals['short'].cumsum()
    
    equity = initial_equity
    for i in range(1, len(df)):
        if signals['long'].iloc[i] == 1:
            position_size = calculate_position_size(equity, risk_percentage)
            stop_loss = calculate_stop_loss(df['Close'].iloc[i], stop_loss_percentage)
            take_profit = calculate_take_profit(df['Close'].iloc[i], take_profit_percentage)
            if df['Close'].iloc[i] < stop_loss or df['Close'].iloc[i] > take_profit:
                equity -= position_size
            else:
                equity += position_size * (df['Close'].iloc[i] - df['Close'].iloc[i-1]) / df['Close'].iloc[i-1]
        elif signals['short'].iloc[i] == -1:
            position_size = calculate_position_size(equity, risk_percentage)
            stop_loss = calculate_stop_loss(df['Close'].iloc[i], stop_loss_percentage)
            take_profit = calculate_take_profit(df['Close'].iloc[i], take_profit_percentage)
            if df['Close'].iloc[i] > stop_loss or df['Close'].iloc[i] < take_profit:
                equity -= position_size
            else:
                equity += position_size * (df['Close'].iloc[i-1] - df['Close'].iloc[i]) / df['Close'].iloc[i-1]
    
    return equity

# Load market data
df = pd.read_csv('market_data.csv')

# Calculate indicators
df = calculate_indicators(df)

# Generate signals
signals = generate_signals(df)

# Backtest strategy
initial_equity = 10000
risk_percentage = 0.02
stop_loss_percentage = 0.1
take_profit_percentage = 0.1
final_equity = backtest(df, signals, initial_equity, risk_percentage, stop_loss_percentage, take_profit_percentage)

print('Final equity:', final_equity)
